Today, hundreds of transport workers took to ALDI across the country to call for safety at work and better sector standards.

ALDI, it’s time to be a responsible client.

2026 is here! 

It’s time to fight for our roads, our skies and our futures.

When Qantas threatens to close its regional bases, it’s the pilots, cabin crew, their families and local community who pay the price.
 
Watch as @twuvictas Chief of Campaigns, Paul, lays out the devastating impact the base closures will have.

There’s nothing that says ‘I’ve changed’ like going on 60 minutes to advertise your memoir.
 
Six years on, and Alan Joyce is still making excuses for the *illegal* decision to outsource 1800 workers.

Read TWU National Secretary Michael Kaine’s opinion piece here: twuaus.com/United-Aviation-JoyceEra

Only one week left until union-won protections for food delivery drivers come into effect! 🛵🎉

These world-first rights will improve standards for all food delivery workers across the country - made possible by TWU gig members after years of campaigning for change. Join the fight by becoming a member today.

Now is the time to act. 

Vote YES to Protected Industrial Action and send a clear message to FedEx: start listening to workers and come back with a fair deal!

FedEx has rejected members' key demands for job security, protections against automation and AI, and wage increases that keep up with the rising cost of living.

FedEx must come back to the table with an offer that stops workers going backwards.

Uber cash payments have started.
 
Drivers have raised serious concerns that carrying cash could increase the risk of robbery and violence on the job.
 
If you're an Uber driver, check the 🔗 in bio to share your thoughts.

TWU members have voted unanimously to take protected industrial action at Cleanaway C&I Dandenong! 

Waste workers at Dandenong have been handed an insulting offer on pay and conditions, and they’ve made it clear: enough is enough.

This dispute comes against the backdrop of Cleanaway’s shocking safety record. Cleanaway workers around the country are pushing for safe conditions, with pressure mounting on workers to work longer and faster while pay goes backwards.

Last week ALP National Conference made a resolution to move companies like Cleanaway out of the federal Comcare insurance system, into the better-equipped state systems for better oversight and accountability for safety.

We are sending a message to Cleanaway, if they refuse to improve these appalling conditions, we will force them to.

FedEx is still refusing to come to the table on worker protections and pay - but workers are ready to fight back. 

Now is the time to act. PAB voting opens today. Vote YES to all items, and send FedEx a message ✊

You might’ve seen coverage about former Qantas CEO Alan Joyce’s new memoir in an attempted ‘redemption’ tour.
 
Unfortunately for Joyce, he’s not speaking to a captured Board anymore.

Read TWU National Secretary Michael Kaine’s opinion piece here: twuaus.com/United-Aviation-JoyceEra

All this talk about the movie - not enough about the hard-fought win for an Aviation Industry Coordination Council, which will hold the industry accountable to the voices of workers, passengers and regional Australia

The union movement has been lucky to have Sally and Michele’s fierce and tireless advocacy.

They have fought alongside transport workers for years, from working tirelessly during the Virgin administration, to standing with workers on strike, to their instrumental role in establishing rights for gig workers.

Thank you Sally and Michele!
